context:
Goal: a grant you type once reaches every session it names, without you typing it again.
Problem (risk): today auto mode never lets a session act on a grant that another session passes on; the change would trust a quoted grant, checked only by the sending session's new guard.
Based on (read): the "Relayed Grant" entry in settings.json never covers an act named in a peer session's message.
Based on (read): the sending session's guard that checks the quoted words against its own log of your messages has not yet been shown to refuse a wrong quote.
Departs from: main never acts on a grant a peer session passes on — a session may do the one act a peer's message names in a line Grant: "<your exact words>" (owner, <time>) covers <act>.
Why yours: a settings change in the cloud is refused by auto mode, so on a yes it goes to your Windows session by mail (measured 2026-11-12, coordinator create_session refused by auto mode as Self-Modification at 17:13 CST).

options.gain: Your grants reach every session they name without you typing them again.
options.how: Your Windows session adds the line to the "Relayed Grant" entry and its test; a session then acts on a grant another session quotes.
options.label: Yes, as written
options.lose: Auto mode trusts a quote from another session, guarded only by a check not yet proven to refuse a wrong quote.

options.gain: No session acts on a grant you did not type to it until the guard is proven.
options.how: Relays stay as today; ask again once the sending guard has refused a wrong quote in a test.
options.label: Not yet (recommended)
options.lose: You type a grant again in each session that needs it.

ref: coordinator 18:49 CST Nov 12; lane draft PR #3038
reply: Closed 18:52 CST: withdrawn, already settled by your ruling of Nov 10 11:06 CST (decision relayed-grant-read-from-page): a relayed act counts only when the receiving session reads your answer on the page itself. Nothing changes.
short: Grants quoted by a peer session
title: May a session act on your grant when another session quotes your exact words to it?
why: It loosens a permission gate in auto mode, which only you can change.
